comparison.objective: Squares a milling vise by sweeping an indicator, adjusting yaw, securing the swivel, and verifying it; the candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1799 requires dynamic indicator traversal, iterative alignment, and cam clamping; the candidate requires coaxial two-tool adjustment and counterholding during jam-nut tightening.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1799 checks indicator span, sweep coverage, secured yaw, and released stability; the candidate checks opening angle, lock retention, drift, and repeated actuation.
comparison.reason: Both retain a setpoint after locking, but indicator-guided fixture alignment and cam securing are meaningfully different from countertorquing coupled threaded elements.

review_notes: Merged millingvise indicator alignment+locking. Compare dynamic setpoint retention while locking; industry label insufficient.
